answer: Before any recovery activates, each approving guardian must pass a fresh liveness check proving they are currently reachable and in control of their key. Approvals from dormant, dead, or long-compromised guardians are ignored, forcing an attacker to maintain live control of every corrupted guardian. A karst out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. From the echo to the walnut, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
